candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment balances[owner] = totalDistributed so the owner's balance stays zero after construction.
Credit the owner with totalRemaining instead of totalDistributed in the constructor.
Delete the line that adds _amount to balances[_to], so recipients' balances never increase during distribution.
Overwrite instead of accumulate: set balances[_to] = _amount rather than adding to the existing balance.
Credit the recipient with totalRemaining tokens instead of _amount.
Subtract _amount from the recipient's balance instead of adding it.
Delete the statement that decrements the caller's allowance, so allowed[_from][msg.sender] is unchanged after transferFrom.
Replace the allowance decrement with an assignment of the transferred amount, so allowed is set to _amount instead of reduced by it.
Replace the allowance decrement with an increase, so allowed[_from][msg.sender] grows by _amount instead of shrinking.
Update the swapped mapping key (allowed[msg.sender][_from]) instead of allowed[_from][msg.sender], so the original allowance entry is unchanged.
Set the allowance to zero on every transferFrom instead of decrementing by _amount, differing whenever the remaining allowance was greater than _amount.
